fields.key_provisions: Engrossed proposal would add public-interest review criteria for retail electric service contracts with large-load customers, including incremental cost recovery and positive benefits to other customers. Its large-load-customer definition uses expected peak demand of 100 MW or greater at one or more contiguous parcels and is not confined to data processing centers. The text separately uses the term large load data center customer in the incremental-cost definition; that wording difference is not silently normalized.
